title: LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: Role code pt replaced by px, which neither the provider documentation (PAT/service key) nor any peer rule names; body and tail are unchanged. Twin of "LangSmith (LangChain) API key (personal access token or service key): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
